entries.question: How should improvement success be judged: which metric or end state matters most?
entries.answer: Success means every executed activation or rollback resolves to immutable execution evidence and expected-versus-observed state; promotion is allowed only after complete bounded observation and successful reconciliation; mismatch, incomplete recovery, or absent authority deterministically blocks promotion and triggers governance; fixtures, npm test, portable build, and AOF verification pass.
entries.expectation_state: runtime captured first-round clarification answers and can proceed to need validation

entries.question: need validation で何が確定したか
entries.answer: The validated need is not deployment automation; it is an auditable execution-to-state reconciliation and promotion authority chain.

entries.question: framework self-audit で次に残る gap は何か
entries.answer: QIF records one reconciliation and disposition but does not yet observe promoted policy-state drift or preserve emergency demotion evidence over time.
entries.expectation_state: Declared activation and rollback now reconcile to evidence-backed observed state; recovery and policy disposition remain bounded and human-governed.
entries.mismatch_state: QIF records one reconciliation and disposition but does not yet observe promoted policy-state drift or preserve emergency demotion evidence over time.
